Black (ORL) establishes himself in Harris' (DET) path prior to the contact.
Robinson (DET) reaches for the ball and places his hand to Wagner's (ORL) front and the contact that occurs is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Bane (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Replay shows Cunningham (DET) is the last to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Suggs (ORL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring at the start of the drive.
After the ball becomes loose, Cunningham (DET) makes marginal contact occurs with Suggs' (ORL) legs as both players pursue the loose ball.
Robinson (DET) directly contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wagner's hand after the release.
Duren (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball from Carter Jr. (ORL) prior to any arm or body contact occurring as he contests the shot attempt near the rim.
Duren (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Green (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) legally contests Wagner's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) makes marginal contact with Carter Jr. (ORL) as Carter Jr. attempts to pass. This contact is marginal and does not rise to the level of a foul.
Green (DET) commits a take foul on Suggs (ORL).
Wagner (ORL) initiates contact with Cunningham's (DET) arm, and the contact occurs before Wagner enters into his upward shooting motion.
Cunningham (DET) intentionally misses the free throw and legally collects the miss as he does not cross the free throw line plane before the ball touches the rim.
Black (ORL) cleanly blocks the jump shot attempt and the contact that occurs with Robinson's (DET) arm thereafter is incidental.
